label: State education property tax
value: Statewide tax with a homestead rate and a nonhomestead rate set for each town every year

source_title: Vermont Department of Taxes: Education Property Tax Rates

label: Property transfer tax, general rate
note: Plus the 0.22% clean water additional tax (total 1.47%). Applies to commercial property, land and long-term rentals.
source_title: Vermont Department of Taxes: Property Transfer Tax

label: Principal residence rate (first $200,000)
note: First $200,000 taxed at 0.5% with no clean water additional tax; value above $200,000 at 1.25% + 0.22% (1.47%).
source_title: Vermont Department of Taxes: Property Transfer Tax

label: Non-principal residence rate
note: For homes fit for year-round living that are not the buyer's principal residence or a long-term rental; 3.62% with the clean water additional tax.
source_title: Vermont Department of Taxes: Property Transfer Tax

label: Clean water additional tax
note: Added to the transfer tax (labelled Clean Water Surcharge by the state); not charged on the first $200,000 of a principal residence.
source_title: Vermont Department of Taxes: Property Transfer Tax
